en: Vintage postcard with a monochrome photograph on the left showing the apse of a large Romanesque cathedral and an adjacent tall square tower in a city street. People in late‑19th‑century clothing walk along the street beside the buildings. Printed captions identify the view as part of Trento, and there is a large diagonal handwritten message and date across the right half of the card. The right side is blank except for this handwriting, indicating the front side of an early postcard.
